summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespace types in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ does prefix matching via startswith on string values, and ClosedNamespace.__contains__ (inherited by _RDFNamespace) returns True only when the reference string equals a stored term URI. Container forms like rdf:_1 are not stored, so they return False. Added NamespaceMembershipTest in test/test_namespace.py covering Namespace prefix positive/negative cases, SH, RDFS label/example, and RDF type/_1. Nothing was run, per instructions (no tests, no execution, no commits), so the changes are verified by reading only.
